core_meaning.primary_meaning: Golara is a Persian-origin name meaning “Flower-adorned”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Golara corresponds to the Persian form گل آرا (Persian گل‌آرا (gol-ārā) 'flower-adorned'). Its core sense is flower-adorned, decorated with flowers. Golara is the Persian گلآرا (gol-ārā) 'flower-adorned, decorated with flowers' (گل 'flower' + آرا 'adorning'), used as a feminine name. The source gave the meaningless غلرة as the 'Arabic form' and glossed it 'golden flower'; both were corrected.
